planRows.shortDesc: We're by Highway 1, about one kilometer from San José's National Convention Center. We offer a free shuttle to and from Juan Santamaría International Airport seven kilometers away. Our hotel features a heated outdoor pool, 24-hour fitness center, and free WiFi. Cariari Country Club and golf course are next door. Visit our bars, cafe, and restaurant.
planRows.headline: Easy access to the National Convention Center
planRows.locationShortDesc: Located 4 miles from SJO Intl. Airport and 7.5 miles from downtown San Jose. Near Oxigeno Human Playground, City Mall, easy access to national parks.
planRows.directionsTo:
From Juan Santamaria International Airport - Drive 4 miles SE on General Canas Highway #1, exit right beneath J. Orlich bridge, drive 0.4 miles the Doubletree hotel will be on your right hand side. 

From Downtown San Jose drive 5.5 miles (5.4 min) NE on General Canas Highway #1, heading towards Juan Santamaria airport.  Exit right on J. Orlich bridge turn left at stop light and return southwest on Canas highway, exit right and drive 600 meters (0.4 mi) on the road parallel to the highway, the Doubletree Hotel will be on your right hand side.

You can also take advantage of our free shuttle service, which departs the hotel every hour starting at 04:00 a.m. until 10:00 p.m. Departures from SJO Intl. Airport are scheduled every hour starting at 4:30 a.m. until 10:30 p.m. For more information please contact us at (506) 2209-1000 or email us at doubletreecariari@cariari.co.cr
